Legendary Resistance (3/Day) If the nuthorghull fails a Saving 
Th row, it can choose to succeed instead.
Amphibious Th e nuthorghull can breathe both air and water 
through its skin, but it needs to be submerged in water at least 
once every 3 hours to avoid drying out and suffocating.
Sensitive Barbels Th e nuthorghull has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks while underwater.
Aquatic Dominion While submerged, the nuthorghull has 
Advantage on attack rolls against creatures without a swim 
speed.
Muddy Behemoth Th e nuthorghull has Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks made while it is underwater.
Voracious Th e nuthorghull can move up to its swim speed 
toward a hostile creature that it can see.
Actions
Bonus Actions
Legendary Actions
Legendary Action Uses 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another 
creature's turn, the nuthorghull can expend a Legendary Action Use to 
take one of the following actions. Th e nuthorghull regains all expended 
Legendary Actions at the start of each of its turns.
Rapid Lunge Th e nuthorghull swims up to 20 ft. and makes a 
Cranial Ram attack, which doesn’t provoke an Opportunity 
Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s reach.
Wide Sweep Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 16, each creature in a 20 
ft. Cone. Failure: 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage, and the target 
is pushed back 10 ft. and has the Prone condition. Success: Half 
damage.
Barbel Vibrations Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 14, each creature 
in the water, in a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. 
Success: Half damage.
Cranial Ram Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the nuthorghull swam 
20+ ft. straight toward the target creature immediately before 
the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage 
and is pushed back 5 ft.. 
Engulfi ng Maw Strength Saving Th row: DC 18, each creature in 
a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: If the creature is Large or smaller, it is 
swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained 
Conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects 
outside the nuthorghull, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the 
start of each of the nuthorghull’s turns. If the nuthorghull takes 
36 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the 
nuthorghull must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Th row 
at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each 
of which falls in a space within 5 ft. of the nuthorghull and unless 
underwater, has the Prone condition. If the nuthorghull dies, 
any swallowed creatures no longer have the Restrained condition 
and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting 
Prone. Th e nuthorghull can swallow up to one Large creature (or 
six Medium creatures or ten Small creatures) at a time.
Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 17
Challenge 14 (XP 11,500; PB 5)
Skills Athletics +11, Perception +7, Stealth +6
Resistances Cold, Bludgeoning, Fire, Poison
Immunities Blindness, Charmed, Frightened, Prone
Blooming Growth Evicting many herbivores, the aquatic plants 
within 6 miles of the Lair have had the chance to flourish. Any 
Foraging Expeditions will yield double the discovered result.
Flourishing Darkness Algae growths thicken and spreads across 
the lakes within 5 miles of the Lair, darkening the depths beneath. 
Aquatic creatures native to the Fenlands have Advantage on 
Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while it is underwater.
Barren Waters Th e nuthorghull's insatiable appetite exhausts 
much of the fi sh within 4 miles of the Lair. All Fishing Expedition 
Casts attempts are made with Disadvantage.
Serene Edge Carnivores have kept their wary distance from the 
lake edge and Travelers can rest without fear of predation. Short 
Rests taken while within 3 miles of the Lair add an additional Hit 
Dice to health regained.
Muddy Banks Th e large amphibian breaching the lake edge has 
flattened plants and turned it into a slick mud within 2 miles of 
its Lair. 10 ft. from the water's edge has turned muddy and costs 
an 5 extra ft. to move through it, creatures that Dash across the 
muddy banks must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity Saving Th row 
or get the Prone condition.
Muck and Silt Within 1 mile of the Lair, underwater visibility 
is reduced to 10 ft. due to stirred-up silt and algae. Creatures 
not native to the Fenlands have Disadvantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks while underwater.
Churning Waters Th e nuthorghull beats its tail in the water, 
Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 15, each creature within water, in a 40 
ft. Cone. Failure: Target creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity 
rolls until the nuthorghull's next turn. 
Depth Drop Th e nuthorghull sinks under the murky water, 
which doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves 
out of an enemy’s reach. Within moments the nuthorghull 
reappears in a free area of water within 40 ft. of itself. 
Retch Th e nuthorghull violently discharges the contents of its 
stomach, including any creatures it has swallowed, which exit 
Prone within 5 ft. of the nuthorghull. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 
14, each creature in a 15 ft. Cone. Failure: 36 (8d8) Acid damage. 
Success: Half damage.
Surging Charge Th e nuthorghull moves its swim speed towards 
a hostile creature it can see. If the nuthorghull reaches its target, 
it can immediately make a Cranial Ram attack against that 
creature.
Billowing Silt Using its long tail, the nuthorghull stirs up clouds of 
mud and muck. Water in a 30 ft. Emanation from the nuthorghull 
becomes heavily obscured until the start of the next round.
[Seasonal] Muddy Banks Violently thrashing its body, the 
nuthorghull splashes the coast with massive amounts of muddy 
water. Th e nuthorghull targets a 20 ft. square area of the ground, 
30 ft. away from it. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 15, each creature in 
that area. Failure: Target creature has the Prone condition.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the nuthorghull 
takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects, the 
nuthorghull can’t use the same effect two rounds in a row.
Lair Actions
Regional Effects
Only in the deepest of lakes and widest of rivers can the massive 
nuthorghull salamander be found. Hiding amongst the dark silt 
and mud, patiently waiting to swallow any that venture too near.

On its turn, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 16, the nuthorghull. 
Success: Th e nuthorghull gains +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total 
AC 20) and Resistance to Slashing for the duration of the combat 
encounter.
Multiattack Th e nuthorghull makes three attacks, using Sweeping 
Tail, Cranial Ram, or Engulfi ng Maw in any combination.
Sweeping Tail Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. 
Hit: 17 (2d10+6) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 
16, one Large or smaller creature the nuthorghull has successfully 
hit with its Sweeping Tail. Failure: Th e target is pushed back 10 ft. 
and has the Prone condition.
